- Initial release of Team Video skill to combine up to 5 team member interview clips into a single polished 1080p merged video.

- Automated token and session setup, including free 100-credit onboarding and error handling.
- Handles exports, file uploads, credit checks, and status queries via simple text commands.
- Provides process summaries, cloud render queue feedback, and smart error messages for unsupported files, expired tokens, and export limits.
